sections.html: Leporinus desmotes is a ringed Leporinus species that reaches a maximum length of about 15-20 cm. It stays much smaller than L. affinis and is not as quarrelsome as its larger cousin.

There are a number of ringed species of Leporinus, each with its own special charm. A shipment of small Leporinus affinis from Peru, about 5 cm long, turned out on closer inspection to consist mostly of another ringed species, Leporinus desmotes. L. affinis will reach up to 30 cm when fully grown. This beautiful fish also resembles the Abramites species.
